book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.0: It was another quiet quarter. Very quiet.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.1: Management looks back happily on three months of top-level lying down.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.2: This quarter was all about rest, routine and even more rest.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.3: Despite the rush (there was no rush) everything got done (there was nothing to do).
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.4: The figures are stable. Remarkably stable. Suspiciously stable.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.5: This quarter too, the Guh Office stayed true to its core values: sleeping and nyeg.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.6: A thorough investigation shows: nothing happened. As planned.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.7: The shareholders (two pillows and a little blanket) are satisfied.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.8: We proudly present: exactly the same result, once again.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.intro.9: A quarter never to forget, though nobody remembers what happened.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.taart.5: Mood on the work floor: 100% content
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.1: The annual plan is finished: it says "nyeg".
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.2: New house rule: whisper after clocking in.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.3: The printer printed one sheet. It was blank. Everyone is proud.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.4: The office plant was watered. Not much else happened.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.5: The suggestion box held one idea: "more pillows". Passed unanimously.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.6: The coffee machine has been named a colleague.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.7: Everyone slept through the fire drill. Passed.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.8: A committee was set up to find out what a committee is.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.9: Staff outing held: everyone slept one desk further along.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.10: The password was changed to "jjjjjjjj". Nobody knows why.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.11: A customer called. We snored back. The customer will call again.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.12: The phone rang. After a while it stopped by itself.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.13: The goal "stay awake until lunch" has been moved to next year.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.14: The new chairs spin. That was the news.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.16: One nibble went missing. The trail leads to a little belly.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.17: The archive was tidied up: it was under a guh.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.18: The New Year's party was in March. Nobody was awake before that.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.19: The minutes of the meeting: "zzz". Approved.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.20: The internet was slow. Nobody noticed.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.21: The deadline was met, by another department.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.22: A desk was added. There is now sleeping in more places.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.23: The office was named the quietest workplace in the Guhmension.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.24: The course "Efficient Yawning" was a great success.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.25: Job requirements tightened: must be able to lie down.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.26: The paperclips were counted. There are still just as many.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.27: The Time Clock ticked. That was the highlight of Tuesday.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.28: The keyboards are warmer than ever.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.29: The staff asked for a siesta. They already had one.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.30: Strategy for next year: the same, but lying down.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.31: A Mika came by to shove. Nobody woke up. He just left again.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.32: The elevator was not used. There is no elevator either.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.33: The meeting about the meeting is postponed until after the meeting.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.34: Friday afternoon drinks began on Monday morning.
book.guhs.guhkantoor.kwartaal.punt.35: A vote was held about the window: open. After that everyone slept fresher.
Conclusion: everything stays as it is. Chonk.
Conclusion: the line is flat, and that takes skill.
Conclusion: no profit, no loss, but well rested.
Conclusion: we do nothing, but we do it very well.
Conclusion: the figures don't lie. They sleep.
Conclusion: stability is a result too.
Conclusion: things are going great, we suspect.
Conclusion: zero is a number too, and a nicely round one.
Conclusion: the plan worked, because there was no plan.
Conclusion: everyone is happy and nobody knows what about.
Conclusion: it won't get better than this. Or worse.

ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhkantoor_loonstroo: After &68 real hours&r of sleep a &dpayslip&r for your guh is ready at the Time Clock. Gross: 0 nibbles. Withheld: a few naps. Read it (right-click in the air) or hang it on the wall. Time simply keeps running while you're away.
